_note: Scaffold of greggman/twgl.js as read 2026-10-14 via gh + npm + README. Nothing installed.
description: A Tiny WebGL helper Library (pronounced like 'wiggle')

versioning.github_releases: none (releases/latest returns 404); npm is the version authority

npm.note: unpacked size covers every dist variant; the shipped runtime is a small fraction

purpose: Reduce WebGL API verbosity; a thin helper over raw WebGL, not a scene graph or renderer. README itself says: for getting things done use three.js.

skyyrose_fit.overlap: three.js already covers the dashboard (frontend/ pins three 0.172 + R3F + drei) and the theme (vanilla three.js). twgl duplicates that role.
skyyrose_fit.only_real_niche: a lightweight full-screen fragment-shader surface (animated background, image-transition or distortion effect) where loading three.js is overkill; one quad, one shader, tiny footprint
surfaces: theme (vanilla, no bundler; vendor self-hosted twgl.min.js)
skyyrose_fit.not_for: product-garment rendering; use three/R3F, where PBR and GLB loading already exist

constraints: Own WebGL context: do not combine with a three.js canvas on one view
Fragment shaders are code; need review for contrast/accessibility and a prefers-reduced-motion path
Brand colours as uniforms from tokens, never hard-coded
gaps: Shader candidates not defined; need founder direction on any effect
